news.headline: Jackson will miss a second consecutive game due to an ankle injury that he sustained during the first half of the Ravens
news.detail: Jackson will miss a second consecutive game due to an ankle injury that he sustained during the first half of the Ravens' Week 4 win against the Titans. As such, Huntley will once again be under center for Baltimore, and the veteran quarterback led his team to a Week 5 overtime victory against Atlan

news.headline: Ravens rule out QB Lamar Jackson; Tyler Huntley to start vs. Browns
news.detail: The Ravens have ruled quarterback Lamar Jackson out for a second straight week, elevating Tyler Huntley to the starting role for Sunday's game in Cleveland.
